readerCopy.headline: Freedom gets loud.
readerCopy.body:
The urge to quit, move, replace the system, or reinvent the whole plan can arrive quickly. Sometimes that is because a real opening has appeared. Sometimes a role, schedule, or agreement has become unworkable because circumstances changed. Sometimes one tedious part of the week is making the entire life look like the problem.

Jupiter square Uranus can make escape and opportunity feel identical. Name the exact part that no longer works before you blow up what still does. If the schedule is the problem, change the schedule before assuming the whole direction has to go.
doNotAssume: Do not assume impulsiveness, rebellion, quitting, a breakup, or that all sudden change is self-chosen.
